DynamicPricingControl.description: **The limits and the autonomy of dynamic pricing at one scope** (29 September, data model DM3). Merges guardrails (ADM-093) and automation policy (ADM-094, ADM-113): both are per-scope controls a price change must pass, and they share the rate-of-change limits.
